versions.changelog:
Initial release of summarize CLI.

- Summarize content from URLs, local files (PDFs, images, audio), and YouTube links.
- Supports multiple AI models (Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI) with API key configuration.
- Offers output customization flags (length, max tokens, JSON, extraction options).
- Includes fallback extraction via Firecrawl and YouTube summarization with Apify support.
- Configurable via a simple JSON file for model and service keys.
